collection.title: Porsche Panamera Panamera Sport Turismo 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Porsche Panamera Sport Turismo 2017 Onwards will fit, this model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 21" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this model, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.

image.alt: Porsche Panamera Panamera Sport Turismo 2017 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
